# AiScope

> AiScope, by Marcstrat, audits how AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and others) discover, crawl, and cite websites — checking crawler access, llms.txt presence, structured data, and live AI citation research.

AiScope is currently an invite-only beta. Agencies, SEO/GEO consultants, and technical marketers can join the waitlist for early access.
